metadata.title: Research Dataset Integrity, Leakage Audit & Final Testing Readiness
metadata.verdict_justification: Phase 8 verified that: (1) Candidate A Test was previously evaluated and published in Phase 7D, disqualifying it as an untouched final holdout; (2) Phase 6 Confirmatory holdout is spent and strictly quarantined under governance rules; (3) Forensic census of raw Borg 2011 shards proves the trace is completely exhausted of unused failing tasks; (4) Randomly splitting previously inspected data is strictly prohibited by research governance. Consequently, the research paper must report existing Phase 7D-7U experiments as development and validation findings, transparently disclosing the absence of an unaccessed independent test partition as a methodological boundary.

candidate_a_provenance.entity_leakage: VERIFIED_ZERO (0 entity or job overlap across train/val/test)

dataset_roles_and_contamination.description: Used exclusively for parameter learning, representation learning, scaler fitting, and k-fold cross-validation.

Used repeatedly across Phases 7D-7U for architecture comparisons, ablation diagnostics, and threshold sweeps. Scientifically valid for validation reporting, but cannot be treated as an unaccessed test holdout.
Evaluated in Phase 7D across Random Forest, LSTM, Transformer, and Hybrid. Its performance was published in reports/phase7d/. Disqualified from serving as a virgin final evaluation holdout.
Evaluated in Phase 6.4, found to have label contamination in Phase 6.8. Quarantined bit-for-bit. Forbidden from access.
Contaminated by post-failure recovery window mislabeling (repaired in Phase 7A). Historical baseline interest only.
Contains sample_task_events*.csv.gz and sample_task_usage*.csv.gz. All tasks with >= 5 pre-failure intervals were previously allocated to Candidate A or Phase 6 holdout.

option_1.name: Existing Untouched Partition
option_1.rationale: Every partition in data/processed/ has either been evaluated (Candidate A Test in Phase 7D, Phase 2 test in Phase 4), exposed to model comparison (Candidate A Val), contaminated by pre-7A labeling bugs, or is the quarantined Phase 6 holdout.

option_2.name: New Chronological Entity-Level Partition from Unused Raw Borg 2011 Trace
option_2.rationale: Forensic trace census (proven in Phase 6 Feasibility Audit) confirmed that 100% of tasks with >= 15 pre-failure intervals and 100% of tasks with >= 5 pre-failure intervals in the raw sample files were already extracted into Candidate A or Phase 6 holdout. Zero unused failing entities with sufficient telemetry remain in data/raw/.

option_3.name: No Valid Independent Test Partition (Transparent Limitation Disclosure)
option_3.rationale: Scientifically honest, defensible, and methodologically sound. Reports existing experimental series (Phase 7D-7U) as developmental and validation findings under strict data governance, while explicitly documenting that Candidate A Test was previously spent and the sample trace is exhausted of independent failure episodes.

models_comparison.primary_weakness: High entity false alarm rate (65.79%) on pure-normal entities; misses 57% of failure episodes.

models_comparison.training_config: 2-layer LSTM, hidden_dim=64, dropout=0.20, Adam lr=1e-3, uniform weights [1,1,1]
models_comparison.primary_weakness: Total majority-class collapse: predicts 100% normal windows, yielding zero sensitivity.
Breaks mode collapse but severely fails Episode Recall (10.0% vs >= 70%) and Critical Recall (8.16% vs >= 50%).
Fails Gate 1 (Episode Recall 30% < 70%, Critical Recall 10.2% < 50%) and Gate 2 (FAR 20.4% > 10%).

models_comparison.training_config: Pretrained LSTM encoder (frozen representations) + Random Forest head
models_comparison.primary_weakness: Extreme false alarm rate (Window FPR 18.57%, Entity FAR 57.89%) despite high sensitivity.

models_comparison.training_config: Task-relative standardized inputs: x_rel = (x - x_base) / sigma_base; LSTM encoder
models_comparison.primary_weakness: Significantly suppresses false alarms from normal high-resource jobs, but misses abrupt failures lacking steady-state baselines.

models_comparison.model_architecture: Linear Hybrid Risk Blend (0.80 S2 + 0.20 S0)
models_comparison.training_config: Ensemble risk score R_hybrid = 0.80 * R_S2 + 0.20 * R_S0; evaluated at Train-OOF operating threshold tau=0.765
models_comparison.primary_weakness: Passes Window FPR (4.40% <= 5%), but fails Entity FAR (24.49% > 10%) and Episode Recall (36.67% < 70%).

models_comparison.training_config: 9 Mamdani rules combining S2 (relative) and S0 (absolute) probabilities; evaluated at fixed tau=0.50

models_comparison.primary_weakness: Reaches 66.67% Episode Recall (near 70% gate), but suffers 48.30% Entity FAR due to rule-firing on transient resource bursts.

rf_vs_lstm_vs_transformer.finding: RF dominates tabular features; LSTM/Transformer suffer majority collapse without weighting

absolute_vs_relative_telemetry.finding: Relative telemetry (S2) reduces false alarms on high-resource batch jobs by >30%

individual_vs_hybrid_ensembles.finding: Linear and fuzzy hybrids improve within-job AUC by +0.033 over pure relative

class_imbalance_treatments.finding: Inverse weighting and Focal loss eliminate mode collapse but trigger excessive false alarms

feature_ablations_m0_to_m5.finding: CPU and Memory dynamics account for 85%+ of predictive signal; Disk/Network marginal

context_window_length_study.finding: L=12 (1 hour) balances early detection with entity survival; L=30 leads to severe survival censoring

post_hoc_risk_calibration.finding: Isotonic and Platt calibration reduce ECE to <0.05, but do not solve underlying Bayes risk

frozen_future_evaluation_protocol.objective: Pre-registered protocol for when an unaccessed independent trace is unlocked (e.g. Google Borg 2019 or new Borg cell).
rules: 1. Dataset Provenance: Must be a completely distinct, unaccessed trace with full event and usage logs.
2. Entity & Job Isolation: Parent-job grouped splitting strictly enforced; zero cross-job leakage.
3. Horizon & Cadence: 300s discrete aggregation grid; L=12 observation window (60 min); 30-min warning horizon; 15-min critical horizon.
4. Causal Telemetry: Task-relative baseline normalization computed strictly from first valid execution step (x - x_base) / sigma_base.
5. Preprocessing Quarantine: Preprocessor parameters (means, stds, missing medians) fitted exclusively on Training partition.
6. Operating Policy: Models evaluated at pre-registered Train-OOF operating thresholds without post-hoc tuning.
7. Reporting: Full operational gates and complementary bootstrap confidence intervals reported without modification.

mandatory_safety_statement: No Google Cloud query was executed. No Borg 2019 data was extracted. No Phase 6 Confirmatory holdout was accessed. No Candidate A Test data was newly accessed during this audit. No model training or evaluation was performed. No existing research results were overwritten.
